scope.snapshot_note: Audited after central LLM gateway and private cache fingerprint enforcement were added.

nodes.label: Vercel daily cron
nodes.evidence: GET /api/collect is scheduled once daily at 30 14 * * *.

nodes.label: GET /api/collect
nodes.evidence: Handler requires exact Bearer CRON_SECRET, accepts date and forceLlm query parameters, then loops configured users.
nodes.notes: No idempotency key, durable rate limit, or distributed lease. forceLlm=1 bypasses the weekly workstyle staleness gate.

nodes.label: Configured-user loop
nodes.evidence: The collect handler sequentially runs collection and workstyle analysis for every configured user.
nodes.notes: No numeric cap on configured user count.

nodes.label: Yesterday + today collection
nodes.evidence: Default targetDates is exactly yesterday and today and is processed sequentially.

nodes.label: User/model summary cache with validated input fingerprint
nodes.evidence: The private Blob path scopes user, date, and model; the stored inputHash is compared when callers provide an input fingerprint. Production read errors and missing Blob credentials fail closed unless WORK_LOG_CACHE_FAIL_OPEN=1 is explicitly set.
nodes.notes: A legitimate miss still permits generation. There is no shared atomic single-flight lease, so concurrent misses can duplicate spend.

nodes.label: Work-log summary LLM
nodes.evidence: Summary delegates to requestLlmResponse with operation work-log-summary and a 1,100-token output cap.

nodes.label: Day-story LLM
nodes.evidence: Day-story generation delegates to requestLlmResponse with a 3,000-token output cap and at most three projects.

nodes.label: Weekly workstyle cache
nodes.evidence: Failure to read prior analysis makes llmStale true; force also bypasses the seven-day freshness check.

nodes.label: Workstyle area LLM
nodes.evidence: At most five top areas plus one arealess group delegate to the gateway; each request caps output at 3,000 tokens.

nodes.label: Workstyle synthesis LLM
nodes.evidence: One gateway request synthesizes up to 40 judgments with a 3,000-token output cap.

nodes.label: Profile handover LLM
nodes.evidence: Profile export delegates one handover synthesis request per user to the gateway with a 3,000-token cap.

nodes.label: Vercel Blob operations
nodes.evidence: Production paths call Vercel Blob list, put, get, and del throughout storage and cache modules.
nodes.notes: Repository proves credential gating but no operation timeout, storage/operation budget, or usage telemetry. Actual pricing and spend attribution are unknown.

nodes.label: GitHub source API
nodes.evidence: Per date, collection performs one /user call and at most five commit-search pages.

nodes.label: Slack source API
nodes.evidence: Each date performs auth.test, one history call per configured channel, and potentially one replies call per returned own threaded message.
nodes.notes: Maximum is 1 + 201*C calls per date, but configured channel count C has no numeric cap.

nodes.label: ClickHouse prompt API
nodes.evidence: Daily and rolling-window prompt queries use authenticated HTTP with SQL LIMIT 200 and LIMIT 4000.
nodes.notes: Infrastructure billing, request timeout, and historical cost attribution are unknown.

nodes.label: POST resume bootstrap
nodes.evidence: When the resume feature is enabled, any authenticated user may upload a PDF and start one LLM bootstrap.
nodes.notes: One call per request, but no durable per-user rate limit or idempotency key.

nodes.label: Resume bootstrap LLM
nodes.evidence: Bootstrap delegates to the central gateway; payload caps output at 8,192 tokens and input text fields by characters.

nodes.label: POST generate candidates
nodes.evidence: Authenticated route reads a user/model/input-fingerprinted extract cache and calls extraction on a legitimate miss.

nodes.label: POST profile delta trigger
nodes.evidence: Authenticated route calls extraction on a cache miss after the profile-delta threshold is met.

nodes.label: User/model/date extraction cache with input fingerprint
nodes.evidence: Production callers supply work-log and resume input fingerprints; private Blob reads validate the stored hash. Production read errors and missing credentials fail closed unless WORK_LOG_CACHE_FAIL_OPEN=1 is explicitly set.
nodes.notes: Writes are non-atomic/fire-and-forget and there is no shared lease, so concurrent legitimate misses can duplicate spend.

nodes.label: Work-log extraction LLM
nodes.evidence: Extraction delegates to the central gateway with a 1,600-token output cap and no retry.

nodes.label: POST generate chat draft
nodes.evidence: Authenticated route may auto-start one asynchronous or synchronous draft generation on a cache miss.
nodes.notes: The single-flight state is process-local and sync mode bypasses it.

nodes.label: In-memory draft single-flight
nodes.evidence: A module singleton tracks one pending task, is lost on restart, and is not shared across serverless instances.
nodes.notes: The five-minute stale check changes state only when polled; it does not abort the network request.

nodes.label: Resume draft LLM
nodes.evidence: Draft generation delegates to the central gateway, caps aggregation at 90 dates/20,000 characters, and caps output at 5,000 tokens.

nodes.label: POST resume agent
nodes.evidence: Authenticated init, message, and revise_diff actions enter the ReAct loop when the agent feature flag is enabled.
nodes.notes: No durable per-user rate limit or request idempotency.

nodes.label: Bounded ReAct loop
nodes.evidence: The loop makes at most ten LLM iterations and processes one tool call per iteration.

nodes.label: Gateway-backed agent LLM
nodes.evidence: Agent delegates to requestLlmResponse with model gpt-5.4 and max_output_tokens 4000.

nodes.label: POST generate section bridges
nodes.evidence: Authenticated route calls bridge generation when cache is absent or caller sets force=true.

nodes.label: Section bridge cache
nodes.evidence: Existing bridges skip generation unless the caller explicitly sets force=true; read failure continues to generation.

nodes.label: Gateway-backed bridge LLM
nodes.evidence: Bridge generation delegates to requestLlmResponse with a 2,000-token output cap.

nodes.label: POST full reconstruction
nodes.evidence: Authenticated route scans local data/daily files, bypasses the extract cache for every entry, then may rebuild from stored PDF text.
nodes.notes: Route is deployed when resume is enabled, but Vercel production normally lacks the local daily-data directory; actual production reachability requires deployment inspection.

nodes.label: Per-worklog extraction loop
nodes.evidence: Every discovered work-log entry bypasses cache and calls the extraction function before writing a fresh cache record.
nodes.notes: Maximum is N extraction calls where N is the number of daily files; N has no numeric cap.

nodes.label: Gateway-backed reconstruction LLM
nodes.evidence: After the entry loop, reconstruction may delegate one 4,096-token request to the central gateway.

nodes.label: Local two-day daily script
nodes.evidence: The script runs yesterday and today sequentially; a comment says launchd invokes it daily at 22:00, but the plist is outside the repository.

nodes.label: Local batch pipeline
nodes.evidence: One date may invoke summary, day-story, background draft, and work-log extraction once each when guards and caches allow.
nodes.notes: At most four LLM calls per date and eight per two-date script execution; concurrent cache misses have no shared lease.

nodes.label: Opt-in embedding quality CLI
nodes.evidence: Embedding scoring is opt-in; normal hot paths explicitly use offline scoring.

nodes.label: Direct embeddings API
nodes.evidence: Opt-in quality scoring posts sequential 256-item batches to a separately configured embedding endpoint.
nodes.notes: Fail-closed opt-in, dedicated token/URL, both kill switches, and direct OpenAI blocking are present. Total text count and per-text input length are not capped; no timeout, cache, or usage/request-ID telemetry.

nodes.label: Dormant gateway LLM family
nodes.evidence: Narrative episode/project, decision, bullet, query-analysis, legacy refinement, strength, and axes helpers now delegate to the gateway, but no live root currently invokes their parent pipelines.
nodes.notes: Other gateway anchors include resumeRecluster.mjs:1044, resumeDecisionExtractor.mjs:325, resumeBulletTextGenerator.mjs:1179, resumeQueryAnalyzer.mjs:761, resumeChatDraftService.mjs:269, resumeReconstruction.mjs:2155 and :2904.

nodes.label: Central LLM gateway
nodes.evidence: Gateway blocks direct OpenAI by default, enforces HTTPS, kill switches, positive output caps, a 45-second abort, 100 calls per process, and structured token/request telemetry.
nodes.notes: The call ceiling is process-local/configurable and is not a durable rate limit, distributed lease, or monetary budget.
